<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="EXPENSE_PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="EXPENSE_PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_DEPT" name="Expense Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>hasAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>createAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>accountReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reviewAuto</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>underLimit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>autoApprove</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approvedMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>deposit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endPaid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>timer7</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendProgress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endProgress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>timer30</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endCancelled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SUP" name="Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Expense report received" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="hasAccount" name="Employee has account?" />
    <bpmn:task id="createAccount" name="Create a new account" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="accountReady" name="Account ready" />
    <bpmn:task id="reviewAuto" name="Review the report for automatic approval" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="underLimit" name="Amount under $200?" />
    <bpmn:task id="autoApprove" name="Approve the report automatically" />
    <bpmn:task id="approve" name="Approve the report" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="approved" name="Report approved?" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="approvedMerge" name="Report approved" />
    <bpmn:task id="deposit" name="Deposit the reimbursement into the employee's direct deposit bank account" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendRejection" name="Send the rejection notice by email" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endRejected" name="Report rejected" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endPaid" name="Reimbursement paid" />
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="timer7" name="7 days" attachedToRef="approve" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="sendProgress" name="Send the approval in progress email" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endProgress" name="Employee notified of approval in progress" />
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="timer30" name="30 days" attachedToRef="approve" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="sendCancel" name="Send the cancellation notice by email" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endCancelled" name="Process stopped, employee must re-submit the expense report" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="hasAccount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" name="no" sourceRef="hasAccount" targetRef="createAccount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" name="yes" sourceRef="hasAccount" targetRef="accountReady" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="createAccount" targetRef="accountReady" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="accountReady" targetRef="reviewAuto" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="reviewAuto" targetRef="underLimit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="yes" sourceRef="underLimit" targetRef="autoApprove" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="no" sourceRef="underLimit" targetRef="approve" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="autoApprove" targetRef="approvedMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="approve" targetRef="approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" name="yes" sourceRef="approved" targetRef="approvedMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" name="no" sourceRef="approved" targetRef="sendRejection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="sendRejection" targetRef="endRejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="approvedMerge" targetRef="deposit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="deposit" targetRef="endPaid" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="timer7" targetRef="sendProgress" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="sendProgress" targetRef="endProgress" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f18" sourceRef="timer30" targetRef="sendCancel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f19" sourceRef="sendCancel" targetRef="endCancelled" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
